doc: Battle hero actors (M2-HER-1103, ADR 0190): how a hero's battle model crossfades between the clip contract's clips (docs/kb/tech/battle_presentation.md 'Clip contract'). Read by HeroBattleActor (game/hero_motion/hero_battle_actor.gd), the root of game/hero_motion/battle/<hero>_battle_actor.tscn. Seconds, at battle speed 1 (the AnimationPlayer's speed_scale scales them with the battle speed).

blend.doc: default_sec: any change no row names (the import rule's 0.3). rows: [from, to, sec]; '*' is every clip the model has. Rows apply in order, so a named pair after a '*' row overrides it. A strike clip blends in fast so its anticipation is not swallowed (attack's contact is at 0.33 s); hit, dodge and ko blend in fast so the reaction reads on the contact; a revive (ko -> idle) stands up over a longer blend instead of springing up; victory eases in and out. placeholder_cap_sec caps any blend into a placeholder clip (a model missing part of the contract) that swings a bone faster than placeholder_fast_deg_per_sec: its limbs swing fast and far, and a longer fade blends nearly opposite rotations, which flips (M2-HER-1114). A model with characters' optional revive clip (M2-CHR-513) stands up through it: it starts on the ko's last frame, so it blends in fast and out at the default.

placeholder_doc: placeholder_max_key_step_deg: a model missing part of the clip contract gets BattlePlaceholderClips' placeholders; HeroBattleActor splits any of their rotation steps above this (and keeps each key on the short side), so a cross-fade into one never flips a limb (M2-HER-1114).

idle_phase_sec.doc: Seconds into the idle loop each hero starts at when the battle opens, so the party does not breathe in step.
